item.title: Self-Hosted Centralized Journal Collection: Graylog vs Vector vs systemd-journal-remote
item.description: Every Linux system running systemd generates structured journal entries through journald. These entries contain system logs, application output, kernel messages, and audit records — all in a binary format that is efficient for local querying but impractical for centralized analysis. Collecting journal entries from multiple servers into a single location enables cross-host correlation, centralized alerting, and long-term retention.
